executiveSummary.headline: Protect a Strong Luxury Position With Precise Property Facts
executiveSummary.lead: Castillo Hotel Son Vida holds a solid mid-strength position at 50.0% consideration and 62.1% scenario presence, ranking first among four Marriott Bonvoy peers. The priority is accuracy and clarity, not exaggerated visibility-growth claims.
executiveSummary.metricsNote: These metrics describe presence in monitored AI answers—not bookings, revenue, or traveler exposure.

themes.title: Spa Size Requires a Direct Correction
themes.what: The same Marriott overview describes the spa as both 900 square metres and 990 square metres.
themes.whyItMatters: A luxury property should present one verified amenity specification across every public page section and all current relevant structured fields; the conflict is concrete, guest-facing, and straightforward to resolve.

themes.title: Luxury Attributes Should Read as One Story
themes.what: The official proposition combines an adults-only castle, Luxury Collection identity, Arabella golf access, spa and wellness, plus meetings and weddings content.
themes.whyItMatters: Accurate relationship and service language helps guests and planners understand the complete resort experience without overstating ownership, access, availability, or seasonal operating conditions online.

themes.title: Technical and Competitive Questions Stay Bounded
themes.what: A Marriott GET produced an Akamai 403 pattern, while Hotel Saratoga displaced Castillo in only three ADP scenarios.
themes.whyItMatters: These are limited investigation signals, not proof of a public outage, official content failure, traveler preference, or any broad competitive weakness requiring immediate hotel commercial repositioning strategy.

priorities.action: Align castle, golf, wellness, and events facts

executiveSummary.successLooksLike: The spa has one approved size, core luxury attributes and partner relationships are consistently described, and narrow technical and competitive questions have documented outcomes.
executiveSummary.closing: Executive Takeaway: Castillo Hotel Son Vida already has a credible measured position. Management should protect it by correcting the spa inconsistency and tightening how the castle, adults-only, golf, wellness, meetings, and wedding offer works together—without treating three displacement scenarios as a strategic crisis.

actions.headline: Correct the Conflicting Spa Size on the Marriott Overview
actions.priorityWhy: The same official page gives two different measurements for one core luxury amenity.
actions.whatWeFound: The Marriott overview describes a 900-square-metre spa in its introduction and 990 square metres in the amenities section.
actions.whyItMatters: Concrete inconsistencies reduce confidence in premium property information and can be repeated by downstream systems. The hotel must confirm the correct figure before Marriott edits the page.
recommendedSteps: Spa operations confirms the measured and approved figure.
Marriott content support identifies every occurrence and structured field.
Replace the incorrect value and align units and formatting.
actions.supportingParties: Marriott digital content team; hotel marketing
actions.suggestedTimeframe: Confirmation in 1 week; correction within 2–3 weeks
actions.timeframeNote: Timing is proposed and requires accountable-owner agreement.

completionCriteria.investigationCompleted: Written spa-operations confirmation establishes the approved area and measurement convention.
completionCriteria.correctionSubmitted: A Marriott content ticket identifies both conflicting page locations and the approved replacement.
completionCriteria.correctionVerifiedLive: Every overview occurrence and relevant structured field shows the same approved spa size.
completionCriteria.noChangeRequired: Valid only if the hotel documents that the figures describe different areas and the page is revised to label those scopes clearly.

actions.hotelApprovalNotes: Spa operations must confirm the correct measurement and whether any figures use different scopes.

changesOrInvestigation: Locate both spa-size strings and related metadata.
Confirm measurement scope and approved value.
Update introduction, amenities copy, and any structured field.
technicalDetails.verificationMethod: Spa sign-off plus live-page text search and source/structured-data review.
dependencies: Spa operations must confirm the correct measurement and whether any figures use different scopes.
technicalDetails.notes: No paid research or ADP remeasurement was performed.

actions.headline: Align Castle, Adults-Only, Golf, Wellness, and Events Facts
actions.priorityWhy: These verified official attributes define the luxury proposition and should use precise relationship language.
actions.whatWeFound: Official content presents an adults-only Luxury Collection castle, Arabella golf access, spa and wellness, and meetings and weddings content.
actions.whyItMatters: A signed fact architecture helps guests and planners understand what is on property, partner-provided, seasonal, or subject to policy without diluting the hotel’s distinctive luxury story.
recommendedSteps: Approve terminology for castle heritage, adults-only policy, golf relationship, spa, meetings, and weddings.
Map each fact to official overview and events content.
Clarify access versus ownership for golf.
actions.supportingParties: Operations; Arabella Golf; weddings/events; Marriott digital content
actions.suggestedTimeframe: Fact approval in 2 weeks; updates within 30–45 days
actions.timeframeNote: Timing is proposed and requires accountable-owner agreement.

actions.headline: Investigate Marriott Property-Page Access for Intended Crawlers
actions.priorityWhy: A bounded automated GET received an Akamai 403 after redirect, while robots.txt was available.
actions.whatWeFound: Marriott robots.txt returned 200 and did not disallow the property overview path; the automated GET redirected to default.mi and returned 403, while HEAD returned 200.
actions.whyItMatters: Marriott should verify intended behavior before any platform change. The probe does not establish a public outage or universal crawler block.
recommendedSteps: Open a Marriott/Akamai ticket with the redirect chain.
Retest overview and events pages from agreed clients and regions.
Document expected behavior or approved remediation.
actions.timeframeNote: Timing is proposed and requires accountable-owner agreement.

completionCriteria.investigationCompleted: The platform ticket documents robots policy, redirect chain, status behavior, client, and region.
completionCriteria.correctionSubmitted: If a mismatch is confirmed, Marriott submits a narrow approved platform change.
completionCriteria.correctionVerifiedLive: Agreed clients retest the overview and events pages with results recorded.
completionCriteria.noChangeRequired: Valid if Marriott confirms expected behavior and intended crawlers receive content; rationale is filed.
